title: REQ · A scene with a second NPC from data validates
summary: sceneSchema and validateWorld accept a scene holding a second NPC listed in the world
description: Context: sceneSchema.characters and validateWorld already check scene characters. Desired behavior: an in-memory scene with boy plus a second NPC parses and validates cleanly. Expected result: no schema issues and no validateWorld errors. Why: proves NPCs are data-driven.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene object with characters boy and npc, when sceneSchema.safeParse runs, then success is true and two characters are returned
Given world.characters lists boy and npc, when validateWorld runs, then it returns an empty array

in_scope: Schema and validateWorld acceptance of two characters
